name: @agentry/workbench
description: The Agentry Workbench — the local Agent Center: a React + Vite + Tiptap + React Flow app over a file-watching local service. This root package orchestrates the two-artifact build (web SPA + server bundle) and is the anchor whose @agentry/* workspace deps the server's dist-lockstep hash walks (so @agentry/flow/src is covered). See VISION.md.
